017package org.apache.juneau.rest.client;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021
022import java.net.*;
023import java.time.*;
024import java.util.*;
025
026/**
027 * A fully-resolved, transport-layer HTTP request.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * All values (URIs, headers, bodies) are evaluated before this object is constructed — suppliers have been
031 * invoked, {@code null}-valued parts have been filtered, and the final URI has been assembled with query
032 * parameters and path substitutions applied.
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * Transport implementations receive a {@link TransportRequest} and are responsible for executing it against
036 * the remote server, returning a {@link TransportResponse}.
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * <b>Beta — API subject to change.</b>
040 *
041 * @since 9.2.1
042 */
043public final class TransportRequest {
044
045   // Methods defined as idempotent by RFC 7231 §4.2.2 — replaying them cannot change server state beyond a
046   // single application of the request, so a transport may safely re-send them once on a fresh connection.
047   private static final Set<String> IDEMPOTENT_METHODS = Set.of("GET", "HEAD", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS", "TRACE");
048
049   private final String method;
050   private final URI uri;
051   private final List<TransportHeader> headers;
052   private final TransportBody body;
053   private final Duration timeout;
054
055   private TransportRequest(Builder builder) {
056      this.method = assertArgNotNull("method", builder.method);
057      this.uri = assertArgNotNull("uri", builder.uri);
058      this.headers = List.copyOf(builder.headers);
059      this.body = builder.body;
060      this.timeout = builder.timeout;
061   }
062
063   /** Returns a new {@link Builder}. */
064   public static Builder builder() {
065      return new Builder();
066   }
067
068   /**
069    * Returns the HTTP method (e.g. {@code "GET"}, {@code "POST"}).
070    *
071    * @return The method. Never <jk>null</jk>.
072    */
073   public String getMethod() {
074      return method;
075   }
076
077   /**
078    * Returns the fully-resolved request URI, including query string.
079    *
080    * @return The URI. Never <jk>null</jk>.
081    */
082   public URI getUri() {
083      return uri;
084   }
085
086   /**
087    * Returns all request headers in the order they should be sent.
088    *
089    * @return An unmodifiable list. Never <jk>null</jk>.
090    */
091   public List<TransportHeader> getHeaders() {
092      return headers;
093   }
094
095   /**
096    * Returns the first header with the given name (case-insensitive), or {@code null} if absent.
097    *
098    * @param name The header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
099    * @return The first matching header, or <jk>null</jk> if absent.
100    */
101   public TransportHeader getFirstHeader(String name) {
102      return headers.stream()
103         .filter(h -> eqic(h.name(), name))
104         .findFirst()
105         .orElse(null);
106   }
107
108   /**
109    * Returns the request body, or {@code null} if this is a body-less request (e.g. GET, HEAD).
110    *
111    * @return The body, possibly <jk>null</jk>.
112    */
113   public TransportBody getBody() {
114      return body;
115   }
116
117   /**
118    * Returns {@code true} if this request can be transparently re-sent once after a stale-connection failure.
119    *
120    * <p>
121    * A pooled keep-alive socket can be torn down by the server between requests; when a transport then reuses
122    * that socket the first write fails before any response is received (e.g. an early {@code EOF} or a
123    * {@code NoHttpResponseException}).  Such a failure is safe to retry on a fresh connection <b>only</b> when
124    * replaying the request cannot cause a duplicate side effect, which requires both of:
125    * <ul>
126    *    <li>an <a class="doclink" href="https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7231#section-4.2.2">idempotent</a>
127    *       HTTP method ({@code GET}, {@code HEAD}, {@code PUT}, {@code DELETE}, {@code OPTIONS}, {@code TRACE}) — never
128    *       {@code POST} or any other non-idempotent method, and
129    *    <li>a body that is either absent or {@link TransportBody#isRepeatable() repeatable}, so the exact same bytes
130    *       can be written again.
131    * </ul>
132    *
133    * <p>
134    * When in doubt this returns {@code false} — the caller must fail closed rather than risk double-executing a
135    * request.
136    *
137    * @return {@code true} if the request is provably safe to replay once.
138    */
139   public boolean isSafeToReplay() {
140      return IDEMPOTENT_METHODS.contains(method.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)) && (body == null || body.isRepeatable());
141   }
142
143   /**
144    * Returns the per-call response timeout, or {@code null} if none was set.
145    *
146    * <p>
147    * Transports apply this as the response/read timeout for the request; a {@code null} value means the
148    * transport's own default applies.  Connect timeouts remain a client-level concern.
149    *
150    * @return The response timeout, possibly <jk>null</jk>.
151    */
152   public Duration getTimeout() {
153      return timeout;
154   }
155
156   // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
157   // Builder
158   // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
159
160   /**
161    * Fluent builder for {@link TransportRequest}.
162    *
163    * <p>
164    * <b>Beta — API subject to change.</b>
165    *
166    * @since 9.2.1
167    */
168   public static final class Builder {
169
170      String method;
171      URI uri;
172      final List<TransportHeader> headers = l();
173      TransportBody body;
174      Duration timeout;
175
176      private Builder() {}
177
178      /**
179       * Sets the HTTP method.
180       *
181       * @param value The method (e.g. {@code "GET"}). Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
182       * @return This object.
183       */
184      public Builder method(String value) {
185         method = value;
186         return this;
187      }
188
189      /**
190       * Sets the request URI.
191       *
192       * @param value The URI. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
193       * @return This object.
194       */
195      public Builder uri(URI value) {
196         uri = value;
197         return this;
198      }
199
200      /**
201       * Sets the request URI from a string.
202       *
203       * @param value The URI string. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
204       * @return This object.
205       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the string is not a valid URI.
206       */
207      public Builder uri(String value) {
208         try {
209            uri = new URI(value);
210         } catch (URISyntaxException e) {
211            throw iaex(e, "Invalid URI: %s", value);
212         }
213         return this;
214      }
215
216      /**
217       * Appends a request header.
218       *
219       * @param name The header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
220       * @param value The header value. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
221       * @return This object.
222       */
223      public Builder header(String name, String value) {
224         headers.add(TransportHeader.of(name, value));
225         return this;
226      }
227
228      /**
229       * Appends multiple request headers.
230       *
231       * @param value The headers to add. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
232       * @return This object.
233       */
234      public Builder headers(Collection<TransportHeader> value) {
235         headers.addAll(value);
236         return this;
237      }
238
239      /**
240       * Sets the request body.
241       *
242       * @param value The body. May be <jk>null</jk> for body-less requests.
243       * @return This object.
244       */
245      public Builder body(TransportBody value) {
246         body = value;
247         return this;
248      }
249
250      /**
251       * Sets the per-call response timeout.
252       *
253       * @param value The response timeout. May be <jk>null</jk> to use the transport default.
254       * @return This object.
255       */
256      public Builder timeout(Duration value) {
257         timeout = value;
258         return this;
259      }
260
261      /**
262       * Builds and returns the {@link TransportRequest}.
263       *
264       * @return A new instance. Never <jk>null</jk>.
265       */
266      public TransportRequest build() {
267         return new TransportRequest(this);
268      }
269   }
270}
